channel.title: Joel Cook
channel.description: What I built, how it works, and what it saved.

item.title: The $600k proposal and the filing problem
item.description: Years of documents, inconsistent filing, and a move from Workday to Banner. I built the classifier in-house.

item.title: 84% cheaper, and I still want the bill lower
item.description: $50k became $8k for a site serving 250k monthly visitors. I wanted to go further.

item.title: The morning our giving site became a casino
item.description: A phone call, a hijacked giving site, and an attacker who could still get in after the patch.

item.title: Apparently, students do want a chatbot
item.description: $47k saved per year. More than 9,000 weekly chats. It started with a bot that needed the question worded just right.
